notes.title: IndieCade 2020 Winner - Narrative Award
notes.content:
Woohoooo! We are psyched that IndieCade has recognised our vision of making a game with a deep story about love, longing and loneliness.
It is not only in the monologue and dialogue we tell the story, but also in the game mechanics and the graphics, they all go hand in hand to convey our story. 
We couldn't have thought of a better award for our game! 

Thanks Indiecade 😘

notes.title: Patch for v.1.0
notes.content: We have made a patch that fixes the frame-rate issue and some other bugs players have been reporting. We also re-added the missing achievements. It was hard work ;) Enjoy :)
